thornkeep.name: Thornkeep
notable_features: Ancient stone walls dating to the First Age
The Undercroft (vast crypt system beneath the city)
thornkeep.description: Thornkeep sits on a strategic crossroads in the Eastern Highlands. Built atop ancient ruins, the city has weathered countless wars and sieges. Its massive stone walls have protected generations of inhabitants, though the recent infiltration by the Crimson Hand has shown that stone walls cannot stop betrayal from within.
thornkeep.history: Founded over a thousand years ago on the ruins of an even older civilization. The name comes from the thorny rose vines that grow wild on the ancient walls. The city has served as a bulwark against threats from the east for centuries.

throne_district.description: The heart of political power in Thornkeep. Contains the keep itself, council chambers, and noble estates.
notable_locations: The Crimson Throne - recently the site of battle with Lord Malachar
Council Chambers - currently organizing reconstruction efforts
Valdris's quarters in the Silver Company wing
throne_district.current_status: Heavily damaged from the battle. Reconstruction underway.

temple_district.description: A peaceful quarter where multiple faiths coexist. The largest temple belongs to the Church of the Dawn.
notable_locations: Temple of the Dawn - where High Priest Aldric tends the wounded
temple_district.current_status: Serving as primary medical facility for wounded defenders

merchant_quarter.description: The economic heart of the city, though trade has slowed considerably due to recent events.
merchant_quarter.current_status: Many shops closed, but essential supplies still available

undercroft.description: An extensive network of crypts and tunnels beneath the city. The Crimson Hand used these for their infiltration. Some sections date back to the First Age and contain mysteries even the oldest city records don't explain.
undercroft.danger_level: High - pockets of Crimson Hand cultists may remain
undercroft.secrets: Party discovered a sealed door marked with ancient runes during their pursuit of Malachar. What lies beyond remains unknown.

thornkeep.current_situation: The city is recovering from Lord Malachar's assault. The Crimson Hand has been driven out, but the damage is extensive. Citizens are frightened and the leadership is in chaos. Captain Mira Stoneforge and the Silver Company are maintaining order while the Council of Lords reorganizes.
quest_opportunities: Clear remaining Crimson Hand cells from the Undercroft
Investigate the mysterious sealed door in the deep crypts
Track down fleeing cultists before they reach Shadowpeak

shadowpeak-mountains.name: Shadowpeak Mountains
shadowpeak-mountains.description: A foreboding mountain range where shadows seem to linger even in full daylight. Ancient legends speak of titans that once walked these peaks before being imprisoned in the depths of the earth. The mountains are largely unexplored, and few who venture into the deep valleys return.
shadowpeak-mountains.history: In the First Age, these mountains were the site of a great cataclysm that reshaped the land. Ancient texts speak of 'the Binding of the Five' - a ritual that imprisoned tremendous powers beneath the peaks. Most scholars consider this mythology, but recent evidence suggests otherwise.

malachars_stronghold.description: Location unknown, but intelligence suggests Lord Malachar has established a fortress somewhere in the Shadowpeak range. Likely built on or near one of the ancient First Age sites.

the_frozen_pass.description: The only known safe route through the Shadowpeak range. Even this 'safe' route is treacherous in winter.
the_frozen_pass.details: A week's journey on foot through mountain terrain. Frequent avalanches, hostile wildlife, and worse.

shadowpeak-mountains.mysteries: What are the 'sleeping titans' Malachar spoke of? How do they relate to the artifacts he seeks? What really happened here in the First Age?
shadowpeak-mountains.quest_relevance: The party must decide whether to pursue Malachar into these mountains or find another way to stop his plans. Valdris, once recovered, may have information about the region from his mercenary days.

the-crimson-tavern.name: The Crimson Tavern
the-crimson-tavern.description: A well-loved establishment where adventurers gather to share tales, form parties, and plan expeditions. The walls are decorated with trophies from Garrick's adventuring days. The tavern's namesake crimson curtains and cushions create a warm, inviting atmosphere - quite different from the sinister Crimson Hand that plagues the region.
the-crimson-tavern.significance: This is where the party first met, drawn together by various circumstances and Garrick's talent for recognizing potential heroes. It serves as their unofficial headquarters when in Thornkeep.
the-crimson-tavern.atmosphere: Warm fireplace, excellent ale, hearty food. A place where guards and merchants mingle freely. The party has a reserved table in the corner where they plan their adventures.
the-crimson-tavern.current_status: Miraculously survived the recent battle with minimal damage. Garrick has opened his doors to refugees and wounded, though he still maintains the bar for those who need a strong drink after hard days.
notable_features: Wall of trophies from Garrick's adventuring days
Secret basement where Garrick keeps his old adventuring gear
Best meat pies in three kingdoms
the-crimson-tavern.meta_significance: Named after your real-world gaming room! This tavern serves as the bridge between the players' physical space and the campaign world - when you're sitting at your table planning adventures, your characters are doing the same in the fictional Crimson Tavern.

the-shattered-spire.name: The Shattered Spire
the-shattered-spire.location: Eastern Highlands, two days from Thornkeep
the-shattered-spire.description: The broken remains of a First Age tower that once reached the clouds. Now only the lower third remains, jutting from the earth like a broken tooth. Lightning seems to strike the spire even on clear days.
the-shattered-spire.history: Built by the same civilization that founded Old Thornkeep. Purpose unknown, but the architecture suggests it was some kind of ritual site or astronomical observatory.
the-shattered-spire.current_relevance: One of the five artifact sites mentioned in Malachar's notes. The party hasn't visited yet, but intelligence suggests the Crimson Hand has already raided this location and claimed whatever artifact was hidden there.
the-shattered-spire.danger_level: Medium - Ancient traps and wandering monsters
